adjudication.evidence: P1 (519–520) shows no sustained shift or return in N/E/U; interior points are missing and surrounding motion is smooth. P2 (525) coincides with a large, abrupt jump in all components (N~0.44, E~10.12, U~17.46) followed by persistent elevated levels over many epochs (525–556), indicating a permanent step—not a temporary platform. No opposing return is observed. Thus, neither candidate qualifies as a genuine temporary offset.
